source_archives_in_image.contents: PGDG .dsc, upstream orig archive, Debian packaging archive, plus the local CNPG data-path patch under patches/

build_patches.reason: PGDG SQL scripts read unit data files from Debian's package path, while CNPG mounts extension files under /extensions/unit/share/extension.

update_and_rebuild_path: Renovate tracks the version-pinned PGDG binary package in metadata.hcl. Rebuild the image on package updates; review the matching package source, dependency versions, control and copyright. The patch is applied with a dry-run guard and fails if PGDG changes these SQL hunks; review any new data-file references before updating the patch. No runtime package installation is required.

runtime_manifest_in_image.generated_from: dpkg-query for the installed extension package, postgresql-${PG_MAJOR}, and Debian packages that own every resolved ldd library path
